name: Object Coast
overview:
​When a mysterious talking Tablet materialized out of thin air, fourteen everyday objects were thrust into the ultimate competition for mind-blowing prizes. The stakes? A modest $100 for 3rd place, a plot of land in Mexico for 2nd place, and for the lucky 1st place winner: total control over Central Asia—including Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Armenia, and Kazakhstan—plus a casual $2.3 million boost to their GDP!

​Divided into two competing teams—the upbeat Smile Pals and the fiercely chaotic Kingdom Troopers—these wacky contestants must battle through absurd challenges, avoid the ominous Detention Zone, and survive constant elimination votes from the viewers at home.
